gaps.description: The registered sorts and terms provide no faithful nullable-list output with JSON null semantics. Unit and Except cannot be substituted without a registered reconstruction that preserves the specified observable output.
The registered formulas cannot express or verify Python standard-library restrictions, absence of external I/O, or absence of retained state across calls.

repair_required: Register nullable-list output semantics and executable JSON reconstruction, plus implementation checks covering S1. Then supply complete declarations, assumption and guarantee bindings, and an existential satisfiability theorem for A1.
